theme_strategy.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss & High-Contrast
theme_strategy.vibe: Premium, engineered, precise, fast. It should feel like a high-end service center or a Formula 1 pit stop, elevating the traditional 'bengkel' experience.
theme_strategy.rationale: Motorcycle owners seek trust and efficiency. A crisp light theme with stark blue contrast provides clarity (trust), while neon-electric blue interactions imply speed (tanpa antre).

typography.instructions: NEVER use Inter for headings. Use fluid typography and tight letter spacing on large text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12) for the landing page to create breathing room. Dense, high-utilization grid (gap-4, p-4) for the Admin Dashboard.

grid_system.marketing: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - asymmetric layouts, overlap, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps.
grid_system.dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for stats, strict hierarchy.

visual_enhancers.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-slate-200. Must always remain readable.
visual_enhancers.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO default shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
visual_enhancers.form_elements: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md max). High contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5} for a precise, engineered look.

hero_background.description: Black and silver cruiser motorcycle in a clean workshop
hero_background.placement: Landing Page Hero Section (Split screen or background with bg-slate-900/40 overlay)

services_bg.placement: Cara Reservasi or About Us section

engine_detail.placement: Service Selection Cards (Overhaul or Heavy Service representation)

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700. Secondary: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200. MUST have transition-colors duration-200.
components.reservation_stepper: Horizontal step indicator showing 1. Layanan -> 2. Jadwal -> 3. Data -> 4. Konfirmasi. Active step in brand blue, inactive in slate-300.
components.service_cards: Selectable cards (radio group logic) with hover border-blue-500 and ring when active. Display duration (1jam, 2jam, etc) prominently.
components.date_time_picker: Shadcn Calendar for dates. Disable Sundays and dynamic holidays. Time slots displayed as a grid-cols-3 or 4 of buttons (08:00 - 16:00). Color-coded capacity indicators.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for success/error notifications (e.g., booking success or admin update).

landing_page.header: Logo 'ALDI MOTOR', Links: Beranda, Layanan, Cara Reservasi, Kontak, CTA: 'Reservasi Sekarang'. Sticky, glassmorphism.
landing_page.hero: Headline: 'Servis Motor Tanpa Antre'. Subheadline: 'Booking jadwal servis motor Anda sekarang. Proses cepat, mekanik handal, tanpa perlu membuang waktu.' CTA 'Buat Reservasi'.
landing_page.layanan: 4 service cards: Servis Ringan (1 jam), Servis Berat (2 jam), Overhaul (4 jam), Request Customer.
landing_page.cara_reservasi: 3-4 visual steps illustrating the ease of booking online and arriving at the shop.

booking_flow.step_1: Select Service. Large clickable area cards.
booking_flow.step_2: Select Date & Time. Calendar left, Time slots right. Slots calculate remaining capacity based on 5 mechanics max.
booking_flow.step_3: Customer Data Form. Name, Phone (WhatsApp), Motorcycle Model, Plate Number. Inline validation.
booking_flow.step_4: Confirmation. Summary of selection. 'Konfirmasi & Lanjut ke WhatsApp' button generates a WA link.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Overview, Calendar, Mechanics, Settings). Topbar with admin profile.
admin_dashboard.overview: Stats cards: Today's Bookings, Available Slots, Active Mechanics.
admin_dashboard.calendar: Full view of reservations. Click to view details.
admin_dashboard.settings: Form to manage operational hours (default 08:00-16:00), holidays, and service durations.

accessibility_and_motion.motion: Use Framer Motion for step transitions in booking form (slide in/out). Hover micro-interactions on all buttons and cards.
accessibility_and_motion.accessibility: Ensure all form inputs have labels. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-now-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Do NOT build datepickers or complex modals from scratch; customize Shadcn.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the booking logic, mock the database interactions using a robust local state or contextual mock API (since full backend isn't specified, but state must WORK accurately for demo). Manage 5 mechanics' capacity strictly: if 5 mechanics are booked for 10:00 AM, the slot is 'Penuh'.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Generate the WhatsApp link using: `https://wa.me/NUMBER?text=ENCODED_MESSAGE`. The number can be a dummy number, but the UX must be complete.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Apply font classes to the body or main layout wrapper to ensure Outfit and Manrope are used correctly.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use sonner for toasts. They are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="admin-login-button"`).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
